proof_basis: GitHub required status checks must pass before a protected-branch PR can merge.
GitHub branch protection can pin a required status check to a specific GitHub App; statuses from another user or integration do not satisfy it.
GitHub branch protection must be configured to apply to administrators to remove the shared owner/admin bypass.
Repository auto-merge must be disabled to block UI/GraphQL auto-merge creation rather than merely waiting to block finalization.
scripts/git/canonical_review_check.py verify-protection returns success only when all three controls are simultaneously present.

entrypoints.control: Actions-app-pinned required exact-head check plus enforce_admins
